title: Toward a First-Principles Update Geometry for the Language-Model Head
abstract: arXiv:2608.22253v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Muon motivates designing optimizer geometry around the function of each parameter block and uses the spectral norm for hidden linear layers. For the language-model head, the spectral norm is not a faithful measure of functional change. Softmax removes shared logit shifts, whereas the spectral norm can assign arbitrarily large size to updates that change no output probability. We therefore treat the LM head and softmax as one module and derive an update geometry for their composition. Hilbert's projective distance respects this invariance as it measures the largest change in pairwise log odds. For an update $S$ with token rows $s_i^\top$, we show that the largest Hilbert distance over $\left\lVert h\right\rVert_2\leq H$ is exactly $H D(S)$, where $D(S)=\max_{i<j}\left\lVert s_i - s_j\right\rVert_2$ is the Euclidean row diameter. translated_title: 迈向语言模型头的第一性原理更新几何
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22253v2 公告类型： replace 摘要： Muon 启发了围绕每个参数块的功能来设计优化器几何结构的思路，并对隐藏的线性层使用谱范数。对于语言模型输出头而言，谱范数并不能忠实地度量功能性变化。Softmax 会消除共享的 logit 偏移，而谱范数却可能给那些完全不改变输出概率的更新赋予任意大的度量值。因此，我们将语言模型输出头和 softmax 视为一个整体模块，并推导出针对二者组合的更新几何结构。Hilbert 投影距离满足这种不变性，因为它度量的是成对对数几率（log odds）的最大变化。对于一个具有词元行 $s_i^\top$ 的更新 $S$，我们证明了在 $\lVert h\rVert_2\leq H$ 约束下的最大 Hilbert 距离恰好为 $H D(S)$，其中 $D(S)=\max_{i<j}\lVert s_i - s_j\rVert_2$ 是欧几里得行直径。在由此得到的 Muon 风格最速下降问题中，这个直径取代了谱范数的位置。一个精确求解……
tldr: 该论文提出将语言模型输出头与softmax视为一个整体模块，用Hilbert投影距离（其上界恰为词元嵌入行的欧几里得直径）替代谱范数来设计Muon风格的更新几何，从而忠实地度量更新对输出概率的实际影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes treating the LM head and softmax as a single module, replacing the spectral norm with Hilbert's projective distance—whose maximum equals the Euclidean row diameter of token embeddings—in Muon-style steepest descent, yielding an update geometry that faithfully measures changes in output probabilities.
